From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clearview.ai>, Katie Lin <katie.lin@meditech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement plan template + initial draft (GDoc / Slides)

Hi Samir / Katie —

Thanks again for the demo last week. I promised to share a concise engagement plan we usually use to align stakeholders and shorten evaluation cycles. I attached a light GDoc template and a one-slide close timeline (pptx) to get us started. The intention is to co-edit the doc so we capture who owns each milestone and the acceptance criteria.

Quick asks:
- Can you add the internal reviewers and the likely go/no-go date in the first pass?
- Any constraints on test dataset access or sandbox environment we should note?

I created two starter links for co-editing: Engagement_Plan_Template.gdoc (high-level milestones) and Close_Timeline_v0.pptx (stakeholder-level timeline). Pull requests welcome — we can firm up at our Friday sync.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

From: Samir Patel <samir@clearview.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Lin <katie.lin@meditech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement plan template + initial draft (GDoc / Slides)

Ben —

Thanks, this looks useful. A few quick notes after a skim:
- We'll need a security checklist entry for PHI handling. I can add the names of our privacy reviewers but need to confirm availability for the week of Nov 23.
- For sandbox access, our infra team prefers temporary API keys scoped to test datasets; if Redwood supports short-lived keys that would speed things up.
- Can we add an acceptance criterion about end-to-end latency being within our SLT (p95 < 350ms) for the demo workload?

I'll add the reviewer names in the doc and flag the timeline where I think our procurement approval will land.

Samir
Head of Data Product | ClearView Health
samir@clearview.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Engagement plan template + initial draft (GDoc / Slides)

Samir —

Appreciate the quick review and the PHI callout. Short replies inline: 
- PHI/security: I'll loop in Rishi on the clearance items and we can add a short SOC2/Security evidence section in the doc. Rishi, can you share the list of artifacts we typically surface for health customers?
- Short-lived keys: Yes — Redwood supports scoped API keys for pilots. I've added a note in the "Sandbox & Access" row suggesting a 7-day rotating key for initial load testing.
- Latency acceptance: Good call — I added p95 <350ms to the acceptance criteria section. We can make it conditional for the production SLA later.

I've also added a proposed pilot window (Nov 29 — Dec 17) on the slide; that lines up with Samir's procurement comment but happy to shift. If everyone is comfortable, can Marissa own the stakeholder communication package and I will own demo setup + infra items?

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
